messages:
marco: Quick Q — onboarding for customer-123 on-prem deployment. Where do I find their Grafana dashboards and live log stream? They claim Fluent Bit -> our OTLP collector is configured but I can't see anything in Grafana or Loki.

anya: Dashboards live in the Customer Deployments org in Grafana. Try: https://grafana.redwood.example.com/d/customer-123-overview (SSO/RBAC required). Main panels: 'ingest-rate', 'tail-latency', 'error-rate'.

kyle: For logs open Logs -> Explore and run: `customer_id="customer-123"` or this direct link: https://logs.redwood.example.com/explore?query=customer_id%3D%22customer-123%22

liz: Quick health checks for OTLP collector:
```
# http health
curl -fsS -k https://otlp-customer-123.internal/health | jq '.'
# gRPC check (grpcurl)
grpcurl -plaintext otlp-customer-123.internal:4317 list
```
If those return ok but no metrics, check Fluent Bit auth errors in their agent logs. Example Fluent Bit output snippet we ask customers to use: 
```
[OUTPUT]
    Name  http
    Match *
    Host  otlp-customer-123.internal
    Port  4318
    URI   /v1/logs
    Header Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>
    tls   On
    tls.verify  On
```

marco: I ran the health endpoint (200) but fluent-bit logs show `401 Unauthorized` when posting. Is there a place to re-check the token quickly?

anya: Tokens are in Secrets Manager under `/customers/customer-123/otlp-token`. I can DM you the path and rotate if needed. Also confirm whether they used remote_write for Prometheus; remote_write target is: `https://prom-remote.redwood.example.com/ingest/customer-123` (mutual TLS optional).

kyle: If it's alerts/alerts noise you're worried about, we recently tuned `customer_high_cardinality` to 10m windows. For noisy on-prem ingest bursts we recommend bumping to 30m and adding `rate() > X` to the expr. Ping me and I can create a PR for the alert rule.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: OTLP collector for customer-123 restarted at 2026-03-17T14:45Z :white_check_mark:

marco: Thanks all — gonna rotate token, ask them to re-forward, and re-check logs link. If still nothing I'll DM @anya the secret path and @kyle for alert-rule changes. Will post updates here. :thumbsup:
